body: This pull request enhances the visualization of the cubed sphere by adjusting the transparency of grid lines on panels outside the user's field of view. As a result, the plots achieve a cleaner and more aesthetically pleasing appearance, thereby enhancing the overall user experience. Below are example plots of the cubed sphere and its 2D projection before and after the modifications introduced in this pull request. **Before modification:** **After modification:** ![cubed_sphere_2D_3D_After_Modification](https://github.com/CliMA/CubedSphere.jl/assets/12926768/a11d35a3-f70d-4e09-b9e8-42595f512ad8)
title: Enhanced Cubed Sphere Visualization
